name: Exp_NRTR_ATR_STOP
summary: This EA implements the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) indicator combined with ATR-based dynamic stops to trail price and generate trend-following entry signals. It opens positions when the NRTR line reverses direction, using ATR to set adaptive stop-loss and take-profit levels. The strategy systematically follows established trends while using the trailing reverse mechanism to lock in profits and exit when the trend reverses.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了NRTR（Nick Rypock跟踪反转）指标与ATR动态止损的结合，通过跟踪价格并生成趋势跟踪入场信号。当NRTR线反转方向时开仓，使用ATR设定自适应止损止盈水平。策略系统性跟随已确立的趋势，同时利用跟踪反转机制锁定利润并在趋势反转时退出。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是NRTR（Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse）指标，这是一种自适应的趋势跟踪工具，通过ATR（平均真实波幅）来动态调整跟踪距离。入场条件为：当NRTR指标线从下降转为上升时开多单，从上升转为下降时开空单，这代表了趋势方向的反转信号。出场条件依赖于NRTR线的再次反转，即持有多单时若NRTR转为下降则平多，持有空单时若NRTR转为上升则平空，形成天然的跟踪止损机制。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，参数中包含LotSize设置。资金管理方面，止损和止盈均基于ATR倍数计算，使得风险敞口能根据市场波动率自适应调整，在高波动期给予更大空间，低波动期收紧止损。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，适合中长周期运行。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) indicator, an adaptive trend-following tool that dynamically adjusts its trailing distance using ATR (Average True Range). Entry conditions are triggered when the NRTR line reverses direction: a shift from declining to rising opens a long position, while a shift from rising to declining opens a short position, signaling a trend reversal. Exit conditions rely on the NRTR line reversing again — if holding a long and NRTR turns downward, the long is closed, and vice versa for shorts, creating a natural trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading via the LotSize parameter. Money management uses ATR-multiple calculations for both stop-loss and take-profit, allowing risk exposure to adapt to market volatility — wider stops in high-volatility environments and tighter stops in low-volatility conditions. The overall strategy logic is clean and represents a classic trend-following system suitable for medium to long timeframe operation.

parameters.description_en: Additional stop level (0=use NRTR signal exit only)

pros: ATR自适应止损机制能根据市场波动率动态调整风险，在不同波动环境下均能合理控制止损距离
NRTR指标趋势跟踪逻辑清晰，反转信号明确，避免了均线等指标常见的频繁假信号问题
策略结构简洁，参数较少，易于理解和优化，降低了过度拟合的风险
pros_en: ATR-adaptive stop mechanism dynamically adjusts risk based on market volatility, providing reasonable stop distances across different volatility regimes
NRTR indicator has clear trend-following logic with definitive reversal signals, avoiding the frequent false signals common with moving average-based approaches
Clean strategy structure with few parameters makes it easy to understand and optimize, reducing overfitting risk
cons: 趋势跟踪系统在震荡市中容易产生频繁的假反转信号，导致连续亏损
缺乏明确的资金管理策略，固定手数交易无法根据账户余额和风险比例动态调整仓位
没有止损保护机制外的额外风控，如最大回撤限制或单日最大亏损限制，存在极端行情下大额亏损的风险
cons_en: As a trend-following system, it is prone to frequent false reversal signals in ranging/choppy markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks explicit money management strategy — fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust position size based on account balance and risk ratio
No additional risk controls beyond the stop mechanism, such as maximum drawdown limits or daily loss caps, creating exposure to large losses in extreme market conditions
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率阈值），在震荡市中减少交易频率或暂停交易，避免假信号亏损
实现基于账户风险比例的动态仓位管理，根据ATR止损距离和可接受风险百分比自动计算最优手数
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility threshold) to reduce trading frequency or pause trading in choppy markets, avoiding false signal losses
Implement risk-percentage-based dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates optimal lot size based on ATR stop distance and acceptable risk percentage

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中会产生连续止损，缺乏市场状态识别机制
固定手数交易不考虑账户规模变化，小账户可能过度承担风险
没有最大回撤或每日亏损限制等硬性风控规则
risk_points_en: Trend-following strategy generates consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets, lacking market regime identification
Fixed lot sizing does not account for account size changes, potentially over-risking small accounts
No hard risk controls such as maximum drawdown or daily loss limits
